CWE-1240.title: Use of a Risk-Prone Cryptographic Algorithm in Quantum Computing Context
CWE-1240.description: The algorithm is vulnerable to cryptanalysis by a sufficiently powerful quantum computer using Shor's algorithm (asymmetric) or Grover's algorithm (symmetric with insufficient key size).
CWE-1240.nist_sp_800_131a: Disallowed or deprecated for new use after 2030 (CNSA 2.0 mandates migration by 2030-2033)
CWE-1240.remediation: Migrate to NIST-selected PQC: ML-KEM (FIPS 203) for key exchange, ML-DSA (FIPS 204) or SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) for signatures.

CWE-327.title: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
CWE-327.description: The algorithm is already broken or deprecated by classical computing attacks, independent of quantum threats.
CWE-327.nist_sp_800_131a: Disallowed (MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES, RC4) -- NIST SP 800-131A Rev 2
CWE-327.remediation: Immediately disable and replace with AES-256-GCM, SHA-256+, TLS 1.2+ with strong cipher suites.

NIST_SP_800_131A.title: NIST SP 800-131A Rev 2 -- Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths

disallowed.RSA_key_transport: Disallowed for key transport (still allowed for signatures with 2048+ bit keys through 2030)

acceptable.AES_128: Acceptable (Grover's reduces to 64-bit security -- use AES-256 for PQC)
acceptable.AES_256: Acceptable and recommended for PQC migration
acceptable.RSA_2048_SIG: Acceptable for signatures through 2030 (migrate to ML-DSA)

CNSA_2_0.title: CNSA 2.0 -- Commercial National Security Algorithm Suite 2.0 (NSA, 2022)

mandatory_pqc.KEM: ML-KEM-1024 (FIPS 203) -- mandatory for NSS key exchange by 2033
mandatory_pqc.SIG: ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) -- mandatory for NSS signatures by 2033
mandatory_pqc.FIRMWARE: ML-DSA-87 mandatory for firmware/software signing by 2025

transition_timeline.2025: Prefer PQC; legacy classical still allowed
transition_timeline.2030: PQC required for all new software/systems
transition_timeline.2033: Legacy classical algorithms disallowed for NSS

ISO_27001_8_24.title: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A 8.24 -- Use of Cryptography
ISO_27001_8_24.description: Organizations shall implement and document cryptographic controls aligned with current cryptographic strength recommendations, with a process for key management and algorithm agility.
ISO_27001_8_24.pqc_relevance: Cryptographic agility planning for post-quantum migration is a direct requirement of maintaining compliance with A.8.24 as NIST PQC standards take effect.
ISO_27001_8_24.remediation: Define a crypto-agility policy; maintain a cryptographic asset inventory (CBOM); establish a PQC migration roadmap with timelines.
